summary: Action required: Cluster health impacted by missing resource limits
description: Your cluster requires you to take action. Your cluster's worker node ${NODE} does not have enough resources to run critical components. At the time of the issue, its CPU usage was ${CPU_USAGE} and its memory usage was ${MEMORY_USAGE}. As a result, your cluster's operation may be impaired. Please ensure that your workloads have CPU and Memory limits set to avoid overcommitting the worker nodes, and consider either reducing application load or increasing worker nodes. For more information on managing resource consumption, please see https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/latest/nodes/clusters/nodes-cluster-limit-ranges.html#.
